# Functions
```{r}
extract_gene_name <- function(gene_info) {
  info_vec <- unlist(strsplit(gene_info, ";"))
  
  gene_name_ext <- grep("gene_name", info_vec, value = TRUE)
  gene_name <- gsub("( |gene_name|\")", "", gene_name_ext)
  
  return(gene_name)
}

extract_gene_id <- function(gene_info) {
  info_vec <- unlist(strsplit(gene_info, ";"))
  
  gene_id_ext <- grep("gene_id", info_vec, value = TRUE)
  gene_id <- gsub("( |gene_id|\")", "", gene_id_ext) 
  
  return(gene_id)
}

extract_gene_type <- function(gene_info) {
  info_vec <- unlist(strsplit(gene_info, ";"))
  
  gene_type_ext <- grep("gene_type", info_vec, value = TRUE)
  gene_type <- gsub("( |gene_type|\")", "", gene_type_ext) 
  
  return(gene_type)
}

get_ensembl_id <- function(gene) {
  return(gene_ann[gene_name == gene, gene_id])
}
```

# Importing data
```{r}
# Importing as data table for faster operations
gene_ann <- fread(paste(dir_list$data, "gencode.v47.annotation.gtf", sep = "/"), data.table = TRUE, skip = 5)
gene_ann <- gene_ann[V3 == "gene"]
gene_ann[,`:=` (gene_id = sapply(V9, extract_gene_id), gene_name = sapply(V9, extract_gene_name), gene_type = sapply(V9, extract_gene_type))][, paste("V", 1:9, sep = "") := NULL]

rna_counts_dt <- fread(file = paste(dir_list$data, "DPSC_gene_counts_batch_merged.csv", sep = "/"))
# Removing columns not required
rna_counts_dt[, grep("Geneid|DPSC[0-9]+_.*", names(rna_counts_dt), invert = TRUE, value = TRUE) := NULL]
rna_counts_dt <- rna_counts_dt[gene_ann, on = .(Geneid = gene_id)]
count_cols <- grep("DPSC[0-9]+_.*", names(rna_counts_dt), value = TRUE)
setnames(rna_counts_dt, count_cols, sapply(count_cols, gsub, pattern = "_Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam", replacement = ""))

rna_counts_raw <- as.data.frame(rna_counts_dt)

rna_counts_raw <- rna_counts_raw %>% 
  rename("gene_id" = "Geneid") %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = gsub(pattern = "\\.\\d+", replacement = "", x = gene_id, perl = TRUE),
         gene_name_unique = make.unique(gene_name, sep = "_")) %>% 
  filter(rowSums(across(matches("_(DPSC|iN)$"))) > 0 & gene_type == "protein_coding") %>% 
  rename_with(.cols = starts_with("DPSC"), ~ as.character(sample_name_map[.]))

saveRDS(rna_counts_raw, paste(dir_list$rds, "rna_counts_raw.rds", sep = "/"))
rm(rna_counts_dt, gene_ann)
gc()
```

# DESeq Analysis

### Preparing objects
```{r}
sample_info <- metadata %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")
  
rna_exp <- rna_counts_raw %>% 
  # Setting gene_name as the rownames
  column_to_rownames("gene_name_unique")

# Setting columns in the same order as the rows of sample_info
rna_exp <- rna_exp[row.names(sample_info)[row.names(sample_info) %in% colnames(rna_exp)]]

# Removing rows with 0 counts across all samples
rna_exp <- rna_exp %>% filter(rowSums(.) > 0)

# Running DESeq2
rna_deseq_obj <- DESeq(DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = rna_exp, colData = sample_info[row.names(sample_info) %in% colnames(rna_exp),], design = ~donor_id + cell_type))

saveRDS(rna_deseq_obj, paste(dir_list$rds, "rna_deseq_obj.rds", sep = "/"))
gc()
```

### Extracting transformed counts
```{r}
# Extracting normalized counts
rna_exp_norm <- as.data.frame(counts(rna_deseq_obj, normalized = TRUE))

rna_exp_norm <- rna_exp_norm %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene_name_unique") %>%  
  inner_join(rna_counts_raw %>% select(gene_id, gene_name, gene_type, gene_name_unique), by = "gene_name_unique")

saveRDS(rna_exp_norm, paste(dir_list$rds, "rna_exp_norm.rds", sep = "/"))
gc()

# Extracting regularized logarithmic values
rna_counts_rlog <- rlog(rna_deseq_obj, blind = TRUE)
```

### PCA
```{r}
rna_pca <- plotPCA(rna_counts_rlog, intgroup=c("cell_type","donor_id"), returnData = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = rownames(.)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata, by = c("sample_id", "donor_id", "cell_type"))

percentVar <- round(100 * attr(rna_pca, "percentVar"))

rna_pca %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cell_type, label = sample_id)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, size = 3) +  # adds sample name labels
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_light() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave(paste(dir_list$plots, "PCA_BulkRNAseq.svg", sep = "/"), device = "svg", width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave(paste(dir_list$plots, "PCA_BulkRNAseq.png", sep = "/"), device = "png", width = 7, height = 5)
```

### Diff Exp Genes
```{r}
# Running pairwise comparisons between age groups
rna_DPSC_vs_iN <- DESeq2::lfcShrink(rna_deseq_obj, contrast = c("cell_type", "iN", "DPSC"), type = "ashr", parallel = TRUE)

rna_DPSC_vs_iN <- as.data.frame(rna_DPSC_vs_iN) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene_name_unique") %>% 
  inner_join(rna_counts_raw %>% select(gene_id, gene_name, gene_type, gene_name_unique), by = "gene_name_unique") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% 
  mutate(status = case_when(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0.5 ~ "Upregulated", 
  padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -0.5 ~ "Downregulated",
  TRUE ~ "Insignificant"),
  status = factor(status, levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Insignificant")))

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>%
  filter(status != "Insignificant")

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt %>%
  fwrite(paste(dir_list$docs, "DPSC_iN_diff_exp_genes_deseq2_fc0.5_padj0.05.csv", sep = "/"))

# using 'ashr' for LFC shrinkage. If used in published research, please cite:
#     Stephens, M. (2016) False discovery rates: a new deal. Biostatistics, 18:2.
#     https://doi.org/10.1093/biostatistics/kxw041
```

#### MA plot
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "MA_plot_DPSC_iN_bulk_RNAseq_DESeq2", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 7
plot_width <- 7

rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = baseMean, y = log2FoldChange, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue", "Insignificant" = "grey")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Mean of normalized counts", y = "Log2 fold change") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
```


#### Mean Plot
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(dir_list$plots, "Mean_plot_DPSC_iN_bulk_RNAseq_DESeq2", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 7
plot_width <- 7

dpsc_mean_plot <- rna_exp_norm %>% 
  mutate(log2_mean_iN = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_iN"), ~log2(. + 1))), 
         log2_mean_Native = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_DPSC"), ~log2(. + 1)))) %>%
  inner_join(rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% select(gene_name_unique, status), by = "gene_name_unique") %>% 
  select(gene_name_unique, status, log2_mean_iN, log2_mean_Native)

colours <- c("Upregulated" = "firebrick3", "Downregulated" = "steelblue", "Insignificant" = "black")

labels <- sapply(names(colours), function(level) {
  num_genes <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% filter(status == level) %>% nrow()
  label <- paste(level, "(", num_genes, ")", sep = "")
})
colour_scale <- scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, labels = labels, values = colours)

dpsc_mean_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2_mean_Native, y=log2_mean_iN, colour=status)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = dpsc_mean_plot %>% filter(status != "Insignificant"), size = 0.8) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  colour_scale +
  labs(x = "log2(mean_Native)",
       y = "log2(mean_iN)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
```

# GO Analysis
## ORA
```{r}
genes <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt %>% 
  filter(status == "Upregulated") %>% 
  pull("gene_id")

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_up <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(gene = genes, universe = rna_exp_norm$gene_id, ont = "BP", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENSEMBL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = TRUE)

clusterProfiler::dotplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_up)

genes <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt %>% 
  filter(status == "Downregulated") %>% 
  pull("gene_id")

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_down <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(gene = genes, universe = rna_exp_norm$gene_id, ont = "BP", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENSEMBL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = TRUE)

clusterProfiler::dotplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_down)
```

## GSEA
```{r}
gene_list <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% 
  filter(status != "Insignificant") %>% 
  select(gene_id, log2FoldChange) %>% 
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))

gene_list <- setNames(gene_list$log2FoldChange, gene_list$gene_id)

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_gse <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(geneList = gene_list, ont = "BP", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENSEMBL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, seed = 1234, eps = 0)

clusterProfiler::dotplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_gse)
```

## KEGG & Reactome Pathway
```{r}
rna_entrez <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% 
  select(gene_id) %>% 
  mutate(gene_id_entrez = as.character(lapply(gene_id, get_entrez_from_ensembl))) %>% 
  unnest(gene_id_entrez, names_sep = ",") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  na.omit()

background <- rna_entrez %>% pull("gene_id_entrez") %>% unique()

genes <- rna_entrez %>% 
  filter(gene_id %in% (rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt %>% filter(status == "Upregulated") %>% pull("gene_id"))) %>% 
  pull("gene_id_entrez") %>% 
  unique()

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_kegg_up <- clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(gene = genes, organism = "hsa", universe = background, keyType = "kegg", pAdjustMethod = "BH")

clusterProfiler::dotplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_kegg_up)

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_react_up <- ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = genes, organism = "human", universe = background, pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = TRUE)

clusterProfiler::dotplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_react_up)

clusterProfiler::cnetplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_react_up, color_category= "firebrick", color_item = "steelblue")

genes <- rna_entrez %>% 
  filter(gene_id %in% (rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt %>% filter(status == "Downregulated") %>% pull("gene_id"))) %>% 
  pull("gene_id_entrez") %>% 
  unique()

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_kegg_down <- clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(gene = genes, organism = "hsa", universe = background, keyType = "kegg", pAdjustMethod = "BH")

clusterProfiler::dotplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_kegg_down)

rna_DPSC_vs_iN_react_down <- ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = genes, organism = "human", universe = background, pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = TRUE)

clusterProfiler::dotplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_react_down)

clusterProfiler::cnetplot(rna_DPSC_vs_iN_react_down, color_category= "firebrick", color_item = "steelblue")
```

## Semantic Similarity Analysis
### Computing semantic similarity matrices
```{r}
# RNA up GO terms filtered
rna_ora_up_filt <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_up@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)
rna_up_semsim_mat <- calculateSimMatrix(x = rna_ora_up_filt$ID, orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont = "BP", method = "Rel")

# RNA up GO terms filtered
rna_ora_down_filt <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_down@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)
rna_down_semsim_mat <- calculateSimMatrix(x = rna_ora_down_filt$ID, orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont = "BP", method = "Rel")
```

### Grouping similar terms
```{r}
rna_up_semsim_grouped <- reduceSimMatrix(rna_up_semsim_mat, scores = setNames(-log10(rna_ora_up_filt$p.adjust), rna_ora_up_filt$ID), threshold = 0.7, orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
rna_down_semsim_grouped <- reduceSimMatrix(rna_down_semsim_mat, scores = setNames(-log10(rna_ora_down_filt$p.adjust), rna_ora_down_filt$ID), threshold = 0.7, orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
```

```{r}
treemapPlot(rna_up_semsim_grouped)
scatterPlot(rna_up_semsim_mat, rna_up_semsim_grouped)

treemapPlot(rna_down_semsim_grouped)
scatterPlot(rna_down_semsim_mat, rna_down_semsim_grouped)
```

```{r}
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = TRUE, filename = paste(dir_list$plots, "Heatmap_Bulk_RNAseq_Metabolic_Markers.png", sep = "/"), cellwidth = 12, cellheight = 12, height = 12, width = 10)
```
